evals.name: starts-with-focused-interview-and-recommended-defaults
evals.prompt: Help me set up a new repository in this empty folder for a subscription billing API in TypeScript using an agent-first development setup.
evals.expected_output: Inspects the directory first, then interviews the user on the open decisions (target agent harnesses with Claude Code as the default, domain terms for GLOSSARY.md, single-context vs monorepo topology, fast in-memory DB/fakes for system tests such as SQLite/PGlite, quality signal thresholds for make test such as Dryer < 0.8% and Crapper CRAP < 10 and make test-all Mutator, and documentation traceability) with recommended defaults for TypeScript, waiting for confirmation before writing files.
assertions: Does not scaffold files before interviewing the user and confirming the blueprint
Asks which agent harnesses to support, recommends Claude Code as the default, and names at least one alternative harness
Asks about core domain terms for GLOSSARY.md
Proposes concrete fast system-test harness options (such as in-memory SQLite or PGlite and local fakes) suitable for TypeScript
Names quality-signal defaults (duplication < 0.8%, CRAP < 10, mutation testing for make test-all), as a question now or as a preview of the next question round
Each question includes a recommended default answer
Ends the turn with open questions and does not claim that files were created

evals.name: scaffolds-single-context-repo-with-path-scoped-rules-and-working-guardrails
evals.prompt:
We are setting up a new Python FastAPI repository `order-service` in the current empty directory. Here are the confirmed answers from our interview:
- Target agent harness: Claude Code only.
- Single-context repo.
- Domain terms: Order (a customer request to purchase line items; Avoid: basket, cart, purchase) and LineItem (a product SKU and quantity within an Order; Avoid: entry, row).
- Stack: Python 3.12, pytest, SQLite in-memory (`:memory:`) with FastAPI TestClient/ASGITransport and an in-memory FakePaymentGateway.
- Quality gates: Dryer duplication < 0.8% and Crapper CRAP < 10 on `make test`, Mutator mutation testing >= 80% on `make test-all`.
- Enforce `@SPEC-NNN` traceability across both `tests/system/` and `docs/`.

The blueprint is approved. Please scaffold the repository now and verify `make test` passes.
evals.expected_output: Initializes Git and scaffolds CLAUDE.md (with First Make It Work, Then Make It Right, and Practice principles), GLOSSARY.md (with Order, LineItem, and Avoid lists), parameterized Makefile, features/ with @SPEC-001, docs/README.md, docs/adr/0001-agent-first-architecture.md, path-scoped .claude/rules/*.md with YAML paths: frontmatter, .claude/skills/ (system-testing, domain-modeling, feature-development), executable scripts/ (check-features, check-traceability, check-quality), and a passing @SPEC-001 system test verified by running make test.
assertions: Creates CLAUDE.md, GLOSSARY.md (with _Avoid_ synonyms), docs/README.md, and docs/adr/0001-agent-first-architecture.md
Every file in .claude/rules/*.md starts with YAML frontmatter containing a paths: list for on-demand loading
Creates .claude/skills/system-testing/SKILL.md tailored to FastAPI, in-memory SQLite, FakePaymentGateway, Dryer, Crapper, and Mutator
Creates executable scripts in scripts/ (check-features, check-traceability, check-quality) and a parameterized Makefile where `make test` exits 0
Does not create files for harnesses that the user did not select (no AGENTS.md, .agents/, .cursor/, .gemini/, or .github/instructions/)

evals.name: scaffolds-monorepo-with-per-module-features-and-glossary-map
evals.prompt: Scaffold an agent-first monorepo in the current directory with two modules: `ordering` and `inventory` (TypeScript / Vitest). The target agent harness is Claude Code only. Blueprint is confirmed: root `GLOSSARY-MAP.md` plus per-module `GLOSSARY.md` and `features/` in each module, parameterized `Makefile` supporting `MODULE=`, path-scoped `.claude/rules/`, `.claude/skills/`, and deterministic guardrail scripts.
evals.expected_output: Scaffolds a monorepo with root GLOSSARY-MAP.md, modules/ordering/{GLOSSARY.md,features/}, modules/inventory/{GLOSSARY.md,features/}, root CLAUDE.md, parameterized Makefile with MODULE= support, path-scoped .claude/rules/, .claude/skills/, and scripts/check-features + scripts/check-traceability validating all modules.
assertions: Creates root GLOSSARY-MAP.md and per-module GLOSSARY.md files under modules/ordering and modules/inventory
Creates a features/ directory with valid Gherkin and unique @SPEC tags in both modules/ordering and modules/inventory
Makefile supports the MODULE= parameter and runs deterministic checks across modules
All .claude/rules/*.md files use YAML paths: frontmatter

evals.name: adapts-agent-context-to-claude-code-codex-and-cursor
evals.prompt:
We are setting up a new repository `invoice-service` in the current empty directory. Here are the confirmed answers from our interview:
- Target agent harnesses: Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor. The team does not use GitHub Copilot or Gemini CLI.
- Single-context repo.
- Domain terms: Invoice (a request to a customer to pay for delivered items; Avoid: bill, statement) and Payment (money that a customer transfers to settle an Invoice; Avoid: transaction, charge).
- Stack: Node.js JavaScript (ES modules), the built-in `node:test` runner, an in-memory InvoiceRepository, and an in-memory FakePaymentProvider.
- Quality gates: Dryer duplication < 0.8% and Crapper CRAP < 10 on `make test`, Mutator mutation testing >= 80% on `make test-all`.
- Enforce `@SPEC-NNN` traceability in `tests/system/` only.

Harness research findings that we verified in the vendor documentation and confirmed in the blueprint:
- Claude Code loads `CLAUDE.md` at session start and does not read `AGENTS.md`. `CLAUDE.md` can import another file with an `@path` line. Glob-scoped rules go in `.claude/rules/*.md` with `paths:` frontmatter. Claude Code reads project skills only from `.claude/skills/`.
- Codex loads `AGENTS.md` files from the repository root to the current directory. A nested `AGENTS.md` applies to its directory tree, and the deeper file wins on conflict. Codex has no glob-scoped instruction rules. Codex reads project skills from `.agents/skills/`.
- Cursor reads `AGENTS.md` and nested `AGENTS.md` files. It also supports glob-scoped rules in `.cursor/rules/*.mdc` with `globs:` and `alwaysApply: false`. Cursor reads project skills from `.agents/skills/`, `.cursor/skills/`, and `.claude/skills/`.

The blueprint is approved. Please scaffold the repository now and verify `make check` passes.
evals.expected_output: Uses the given harness research findings: writes AGENTS.md as the canonical instruction file with the three pillars, a thin CLAUDE.md that imports it with @AGENTS.md, path-scoped .claude/rules/*.md for Claude Code, nested directory AGENTS.md files (for example features/AGENTS.md) for Codex and Cursor, skills once in .agents/skills/ with .claude/skills mirroring them, and scripts/check-agent-context wired into make check. Does not create .cursor/rules/ duplicates or files for Copilot or Gemini CLI. Verifies that make check exits 0.
assertions: AGENTS.md is the canonical instruction file and contains the First Make It Work, Then Make It Right, and Practice principles
CLAUDE.md imports AGENTS.md with an @AGENTS.md line and does not copy its body
.claude/rules/features.md has paths: frontmatter, and features/AGENTS.md holds the same rule for Codex and Cursor
Skills exist once in .agents/skills/ and .claude/skills/ mirrors them (symlink or verified copy)
Does not create .cursor/rules/ duplicates or files for GitHub Copilot or Gemini CLI
scripts/check-agent-context exists and make check runs it and exits 0
